what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the rewards program page Start with the GolfN rewards program page , which explains how points are earned and what they can be redeemed for.
2 Step 2 : Get the app and create a free account Download the app from the GolfN homepage , then set up your profile and fill out your bag. Scorecard and performance tracking are free.
3 Step 3 : Set up your round Before teeing off, enable the digital golf ball and equip up to three Digital Clubs if you own them. Without clubs, a membership adds them to your bag automatically.
4 Step 4 : Play and finish the round Play with the app running. Round activity is verified through your device's location services, and points are added to your balance once the round is complete.

5 Step 5 : Add off-course points Complete your profile, invite friends, upload course photos, write reviews, check in at participating properties and follow GolfN's social accounts to earn more points.
6 Step 6 : Redeem points in the Pro Shop Spend points on gear or sweepstakes entries in the GolfN Pro Shop . Conversion to the GOLF token is not yet available.
